name: Idea-to-Bible Kernel — Skill Rocket
title_zh: JSON 写工作流，Effect-TS 当引擎跑
tagline_zh: 把流程描述和副作用执行拆开：JSON 只管声明，Effect-TS 负责跑。改流程不用动代码。
tagline_en: Separate flow description from side-effect execution: declare in JSON, run on Effect-TS. Change flows without.
desc_en: JSON Effect Scripting Language — a workflow engine on Effect-TS
why_zh: 它把流程定义和执行彻底分离：JSON 是纯数据，Effect-TS 提供类型安全、可测试的运行时。
why_en: Decouples flow definition from execution: JSON stays pure data, Effect-TS gives type-safe, testable runtime. More flexible than.
limit_zh: 只认 JSON 格式的流程定义，不认 YAML；只跑在 Effect-TS 生态里，不接其他运行时。
limit_en: JSON only (no YAML); Effect-TS runtime only; side effects need your own Effect adapters—it won't build them for you.
